spec.prompt: Ambience of an enchanted giant forest floor in late afternoon, heard from the ground among huge leaves and roots: a soft breeze high in giant leaves, distant gentle insect chirps and buzzing, an occasional far-off bird, a faint trickle of water, and a barely audible shimmering ethereal tone like distant glass chimes, mysterious and calm.
